description: Authoritative stage list for film-generation-v2.1. Consumers embed the stages[] array under workflow.stages. verify_checks[] is the CENTRALIZED, canonical registry of all VERIFY rules across v2.1.0/v2.1.1/v2.1.2/v2.1.3 (each rule carries introduced_in for lineage tracking).

input.format: text/markdown or structured narrative + optional NSA H1-H8 handoffs

process.description: Segment story into narrative meta units. Every value carries three-state provenance (explicit/inferred/decision).
rules: each MU has unique mu_id
each MU MUST have function, emotion_intensity(0.0-1.0), entities, core_action, time_marker, world, _provenance
world in enum {modern, ancient, threshold, superimposed, both}
if narrative_proportion.visual >= narrative_proportion.dialogue then core_action MUST be visualizable — no dialogue-only MU allowed
if narrative_proportion.silence >= 0.15 then at least one MU per scene has function=silence_beat
unresolvable ambiguity from source → register in ambiguity_registry (AMB-nn), never silently pick

process.description: Map MU to scenes and sequences; allocate duration budgets; assign 30s containers.
rules: each scene has unique scene_id, location, time, world, continuity_tags
each sequence has unique seq_id, seq_type, duration_budget_sec, maps_to_mu, container_ref
sum of sequences[].duration_budget_sec MUST equal total_duration_budget_sec
each container_ref MUST equal exactly 30.0s of sequences it contains
each container MUST contain exactly 5 shots after S3-IR expansion
container boundary MUST align with a narrative beat — never mid-action
transition_hint optional; used to indicate cross-scene method

process.description: For each sequence, declare motion_reason and cut_reason from the direction_vocabulary. This DRIVES S3-IR camera_motion.type and rhythm_profile.cut_triggers but does NOT appear in the video model prompt.
rules: each DirectionIntent references exactly one seq_id
motion_reason MUST come from MotionGrammar enum
cut_reason MUST come from CutGrammar enum
tension_arc_role MUST be assigned; sum of climb + break + reveal beats per act MUST be non-zero
silence_beats MUST be declared when narrative_proportion.silence >= 0.15
genre preset motion_grammar_defaults_by_beat provides fallback when a sequence's tension_arc_role is set but motion_reason is omitted

process.description: For each MU with visible actor presence, declare inner_want, hidden, breakdown_moment, and micro_life_anchors. Drives Module 12 CHARACTER ACTING and IR talent_action.
rules: each PerformanceIntent references exactly one mu_id and one actor_ref (from character_lock)
inner_want and hidden are always distinct sentences
micro_life_anchors chosen from MicroLifeAtom enum (extend via preset, not per-shot)
reaction_before=true implies the shot following this MU begins with the listener's face frame
if actor_ref has no dialogue in the mapped shot, all micro_life happens on face and hands, never invented vocalization

process.description: Expand sequences into shots. Apply genre preset defaults first; then apply direction_intent and performance_intent as sequence/MU-scoped overrides; then apply preset_override; finally apply per-shot delta only where the shot deviates from all inherited defaults.
rules: each shot has unique shot_id and seq_ref
first shot of each sequence MUST be FULL (no inherits)
subsequent shots in same sequence MAY use inherits + delta
shot_type derived from framing.shot_size + camera_motion.type
duration_frames = round(duration_sec * fps); MUST be integer
mise_en_scene_ref and sound_design_ref MUST resolve into libraries
talent_action derived from PerformanceIntent — must reflect inner_want without stating it verbatim
every hard-value field MUST carry _provenance entry (explicit/inferred/decision, with span or D-ID)
vibration.spectrum and motion_blur_samples are render_hint_only — MUST NOT appear in L2 render_prompt
cross-container shot MUST NOT exist — no shot spans two 30s containers

process.description: Multi-layer verification. On FAIL, compute MUS and either auto-repair via decision rewrite or return to S3-IR for human sign-off.

checks.rule: sum(shots[].temporal.duration_sec) == MSSS.total_duration_budget_sec ± 0.01
sum per container_ref == 30.0 exactly
count per container_ref == 5
all shots share aspect_ratio with workflow
adjacent shot camera_motion axis consistent OR jump signed by decision
sequential framing follows narrative logic (no CU→ELS without motivation)
character features anchor identical across all shots
prop presence and state consistent
world lighting zone consistent; transition lighting matched
montage members unified by theme, rhythm, and visual thread
match_cut elements visually correspondent
every MU covered by at least one shot
measured narrative weight per shot within ±0.10 of workflow.narrative_proportion
measured avg_shot_length within ±20% of pacing_lock.avg_shot_length_sec
silence duration / total ≥ pacing_lock.silence_ratio_min
hard_cut count / total_cuts within ±0.15 of pacing_lock.hard_cut_ratio_target
diegetic sound consistent across world
no L2 module contains music/BGM/OST/score — enforced string scan
world change follows narrative pass and uses declared world_transition_style
distance/speed ≤ duration_frames/fps
rack range within shot near_focus
adjacent shot focal_length_mm jump ≤ 2x unless signed
shutter angle jump ≤ 90° per cut
duration_sec * fps == duration_frames exactly
cut_trigger_frame within [0, duration_frames]
every shot's camera_motion.type consistent with its seq's DirectionIntent.motion_reason (via mapping table)
every actor-present shot's talent_action references at least one MicroLifeAtom from its PerformanceIntent
every hard-value field has _provenance with span, d_id, or explicit witness

L2 render_prompt contains no vibration.spectrum, no motion_blur_samples, no bezier control points, no numeric acceleration curves, no retime_method value, no post_intent values, no transition_duration_frames values
for each shot, temporal.duration_sec MUST fall within preset.duration_hint_by_function[shot._resolved_mu.function] ± 30% tolerance; miss → propose reallocation as decision, do NOT rewrite MU function

for every rhythm_profile.cut_triggers[] whose type in {dissolve, silk_dissolve, fade_to_black, wipe}: transition_duration_frames MUST be present OR preset.transition_duration_defaults_frames[type] MUST be non-zero; hard_cut/match_cut/smash_cut MUST have transition_duration_frames == 0 or omitted

IF audio_beat_track present THEN every cut_triggers[].alignment matching /^@beat_/ AND every Temporal.cut_in_beat_ref / cut_out_beat_ref MUST resolve to some audio_beat_track.beats[].beat_id; unresolved @beat_ ref is a hard fail

IF episode present THEN containers[] length == episode.container_count AND every container.time_start_sec == container.index * 30.0 AND sum(containers[].duration_sec) == episode.total_duration_sec == audio_beat_track.total_length_sec

IF audio_beat_track.beats[].container_ref present THEN container.time_start_sec <= beat.time_sec <= container.time_start_sec + container.duration_sec (30.0); every container.beat_range.first_beat_id / last_beat_id MUST exist in audio_beat_track.beats

IF episode.apex_container_ref present THEN the container it references MUST have the highest tension_peak among containers[]; episode.tension_arc_shape MUST be consistent with the tension_peak sequence (e.g. steady_climb = monotonic non-decreasing; double_peak = exactly two local maxima)

on_fail.compute: MUS (Minimal Unsatisfiable Subset) — smallest set of decision atoms whose removal makes the check pass
on_fail.if_mus_contains_only_decisions: propose new decision values; re-run VERIFY in memory; if PASS emit repair with requires_signoff=true
on_fail.if_mus_contains_explicit_atom: escalate to ambiguity_registry (AMB-nn); do NOT relax explicit; return to human

process.description: Emit three-tier canonical DSL. L1 for review, L2 for video model, L3 for post/audit.
rules: L1_human_readable ~200 bytes per shot: shot_no, shot_size, motion, duration_s, one-sentence beat
L2_render_prompt renders Hell Grind 15 modules verbatim from IR + locks + libraries — Style Prefix and Closing Tag unmodified
L2 must NOT reference render_hint_only fields
L3_full_ir_ref is a pointer into the TypedIR document, NOT a copy
montage_groups, match_cut_pairs, world_timeline, world_transition_map, execution_order populated from IR
cinematography_summary aggregates lens_range, motion_types, longest_take, shortest_shot, avg_shutter, depth_layers_max

verify_checks.description: Unresolvable ambiguity from source text MUST be registered as AMB-nn in ambiguity_registry — never silently resolved.
verify_checks.logic: for choice in inferred_choices: assert choice.registered_in_ambiguity_registry

verify_checks.description: Each MU has function, emotion_intensity in [0.0,1.0], entities, core_action, time_marker, world, _provenance.
verify_checks.logic: for m in mus: assert all(f in m for f in required_mu_fields); assert 0<=m.emotion_intensity<=1

verify_checks.description: If narrative_proportion.silence >= 0.15, at least one MU per scene must have function=silence_beat.
verify_checks.logic: if silence>=0.15: for scene in scenes: assert any(mu.function=='silence_beat' for mu in mus_of(scene))

verify_checks.description: If narrative_proportion.visual >= narrative_proportion.dialogue, no dialogue-only MU allowed — every MU's core_action MUST be visualizable.
verify_checks.logic: if visual>=dialogue: for m in mus: assert m.core_action.visualizable == True

verify_checks.description: MU.world MUST be one of {modern, ancient, threshold, superimposed, both}.
verify_checks.logic: for m in mus: assert m.world in {'modern','ancient','threshold','superimposed','both'}

verify_checks.description: Each meta unit has a unique mu_id across the MUS.
verify_checks.logic: assert len({m.mu_id for m in mus}) == len(mus)

verify_checks.description: Each container_ref MUST equal exactly 30.0s of sequences it contains.
verify_checks.logic: for c in containers: assert sum(sq.duration_budget_sec for sq in c.sequences) == 30.0

verify_checks.description: Each container MUST contain exactly 5 shots after S3-IR expansion.
Container boundary MUST align with a narrative beat — never mid-action.
verify_checks.logic: for b in container_boundaries: assert b.at_narrative_beat == True

verify_checks.description: Sum of sequences[].duration_budget_sec MUST equal total_duration_budget_sec.
verify_checks.logic: assert sum(sq.duration_budget_sec for sq in sequences) == total_duration_budget_sec

verify_checks.description: Each scene has unique scene_id, location, time, world, continuity_tags.
Each sequence has unique seq_id, seq_type, duration_budget_sec, maps_to_mu, container_ref.
cut_reason MUST come from the CutGrammar enum.
Each DirectionIntent references exactly one seq_id.
motion_reason MUST come from the MotionGrammar enum.
silence_beats MUST be declared when narrative_proportion.silence >= 0.15.
tension_arc_role MUST be assigned; sum of climb + break + reveal beats per act MUST be non-zero.
verify_checks.logic: for act in acts: assert count(climb|break|reveal in act) > 0

verify_checks.description: inner_want and hidden MUST always be distinct sentences.
verify_checks.logic: for p in performance_intents: assert p.inner_want != p.hidden

verify_checks.description: micro_life_anchors chosen from MicroLifeAtom enum (extend via preset, not per-shot).
If actor_ref has no dialogue in the mapped shot, all micro_life happens on face and hands — never invented vocalization.
Each PerformanceIntent references exactly one mu_id and one actor_ref (from character_lock).
reaction_before=true implies the shot following this MU begins with the listener's face frame.
Subsequent shots in same sequence MAY use inherits + delta.
First shot of each sequence MUST be FULL (no inherits).
duration_frames = round(duration_sec * fps); MUST be integer.
verify_checks.logic: for sh in shots: assert sh.temporal.duration_frames == round(sh.temporal.duration_sec * sh.temporal.fps)

verify_checks.description: mise_en_scene_ref and sound_design_ref MUST resolve into libraries.
No shot spans two 30s containers.
verify_checks.logic: for sh in shots: assert sh.container_ref is not None and (sh.time_start, sh.time_end) within its container

verify_checks.description: Every hard-value field MUST carry a _provenance entry (explicit/inferred/decision, with span or D-ID).
vibration.spectrum and motion_blur_samples are render_hint_only — MUST NOT appear in L2 render_prompt.
verify_checks.logic: for sh in shots_dsl: for m in sh.L2.modules.values(): assert 'vibration.spectrum' not in m and 'motion_blur_samples' not in m

verify_checks.description: Each shot has a unique shot_id and a valid seq_ref.
shot_type derived from framing.shot_size + camera_motion.type (not user-set).
talent_action derived from PerformanceIntent — MUST reflect inner_want without stating it verbatim.
cinematography_summary aggregates lens_range, motion_types, longest_take, shortest_shot, avg_shutter, depth_layers_max.
L1_human_readable ~200 bytes per shot: shot_no, shot_size, motion, duration_s, one-sentence beat.
L2_render_prompt renders Hell Grind 15 modules verbatim from IR + locks + libraries. Style Prefix and Closing Tag unmodified.
verify_checks.logic: for sh in shots_dsl: assert set(sh.L2.modules.keys()) == MODULE_ORDER_15

verify_checks.description: L2 MUST NOT reference render_hint_only fields (retime_method, post_intent, transition_duration_frames, vibration.spectrum, motion_blur_samples, bezier).
verify_checks.logic: banned = {'retime_method','post_intent','transition_duration_frames','vibration.spectrum','motion_blur_samples','bezier'}

verify_checks.description: L3_full_ir_ref is a pointer into the TypedIR document, NOT a copy.
For each montage_group, the sum of member shots' duration_sec MUST equal group.total_duration_sec.
verify_checks.logic: for g in montage_groups: assert sum(shot.duration_sec for shot in g.members) == g.total_duration_sec

verify_checks.description: montage_groups, match_cut_pairs, world_timeline, world_transition_map, execution_order populated from IR.
If any shot uses cut_in_beat_ref/cut_out_beat_ref/anchor_beat_ref, workflow MUST declare top-level audio_beat_track.
verify_checks.logic: if any(sh.temporal.cut_in_beat_ref or sh.temporal.cut_out_beat_ref for sh in shots): assert 'audio_beat_track' in workflow

verify_checks.description: Shot.post_intent (trim_priority/slip/slide/handle_frames/preferred_anchor) is post-layer hint. It MUST NOT leak into L2 render_prompt modules.
verify_checks.logic: for sh_dsl in shots_dsl: for m in sh_dsl.L2.modules.values(): assert 'post_intent' not in m and 'trim_priority' not in m and 'handle_frames' not in m

verify_checks.description: Temporal.retime_method is a post-layer hint (optical_flow/frame_blend/nearest/timewarp). It MUST NOT leak into L2 render_prompt modules.
verify_checks.logic: for sh_dsl in shots_dsl: for m in sh_dsl.L2.modules.values(): assert 'retime_method' not in m

verify_checks.description: For cut_triggers[].transition_type in {dissolve, silk_dissolve, fade_to_black, wipe} the transition_duration_frames MUST be > 0; for {hard_cut, match_cut, smash_cut} MUST be 0.
verify_checks.logic: for sh in shots: for t in sh.rhythm_profile.cut_triggers: if t.type in NON_INSTANT: assert t.duration_frames>0 else: assert t.duration_frames==0

verify_checks.description: Every cut_triggers[].anchor_beat_ref, Temporal.cut_in_beat_ref, Temporal.cut_out_beat_ref MUST resolve to an existing beat_id in audio_beat_track.beats[].
verify_checks.logic: beat_ids = {b.beat_id for b in audio_beat_track.beats}; for sh in shots: assert every beat_ref in sh in beat_ids

verify_checks.description: When montage_group.scale_lock=true, retimes on members MUST preserve their relative duration ratios (all-or-nothing scaling).
For each shot, if genre_preset defines duration_hint_by_function[mu.function]=[lo,hi], shot.duration_sec MUST be within [lo*0.7, hi*1.3].
verify_checks.logic: for sh in shots: hint = preset.duration_hint_by_function.get(mu_fn(sh)); if hint: lo,hi=hint; assert lo*0.7 <= sh.duration_sec <= hi*1.3

verify_checks.description: container.bridge_to_next.beat_ref (when non-null) MUST resolve to a beat_id in audio_beat_track.beats[] with role in {cross_container_bridge, container_close, container_open}.
container.entry_transition MUST be null (first container) or one of {hard_cut, match_cut, dissolve, silk_dissolve, smash_cut, fade_to_black, wipe}.

For every beat with container_ref set: container.time_start_sec <= beat.time_sec <= container.time_start_sec+30.0. Every container MUST have at least one beat with role=container_open near its start and role=container_close near its end.
verify_checks.logic: for b in beats where container_ref: c=containers[b.container_ref]; assert c.time_start_sec <= b.time_sec <= c.time_start_sec+30

verify_checks.description: For every container: time_start_sec MUST equal index*30.0 and duration_sec MUST be exactly 30.0. Sum of container durations MUST equal episode.total_duration_sec and audio_beat_track.total_length_sec.
verify_checks.logic: for c in containers: assert c.time_start_sec == c.index*30.0 and c.duration_sec == 30.0; assert sum(c.duration_sec)==episode.total_duration_sec==audio_beat_track.total_length_sec

verify_checks.description: For every shot: shot.container_ref MUST match the container whose (time_start_sec, time_start_sec+30) window contains the shot's cumulative timeline position.
verify_checks.logic: for sh in shots: t0=cumulative_start(sh); assert containers_by_id[sh.container_ref].time_start_sec <= t0 < containers_by_id[sh.container_ref].time_start_sec+30

verify_checks.description: episode.apex_container_ref MUST resolve to a container whose tension_peak is the maximum across containers (single-apex arcs) or one of the top-N peaks (multi-apex arcs). For arcs beginning with 'long_tail_late_break' the apex container index MUST be >=2 (late apex).
verify_checks.logic: apex_c = containers[episode.apex_container_ref]; if 'long_tail' in arc: assert apex_c.index >= 2; if 'double' not in arc: assert apex_c.tension_peak == max(c.tension_peak)

verify_checks.description: For 10-container episodes, count of 'apex' roles must match arc's apex profile (1 for single-apex arcs, 2 for double-peak arcs).
verify_checks.logic: if episode.container_count == 10: apex_n = sum(1 for c in containers if c.role == 'apex'); if arc.startswith('double_peak'): assert apex_n == 2 else: assert apex_n == 1

verify_checks.description: For 10-container episodes, at least 2 container boundaries must include a silence_pocket bridge to give the audience recovery between escalations.
verify_checks.logic: if episode.container_count == 10: silence_n = sum(1 for c in containers if c.bridge_to_next.mode == 'silence_pocket'); assert silence_n >= 2

verify_checks.description: For any episode ≥ 5 containers, the final container's out-transition must be dissolve/silk_dissolve/fade_to_black — not a hard/match/smash cut.
verify_checks.logic: last = containers[-1]; last_shot = shots[last.container_id][-1]; out_type = last_shot.rhythm_profile.cut_triggers[-1].transition_type; assert out_type in ('dissolve', 'silk_dissolve', 'fade_to_black')
